summary: Example: when: "" warns 'Empty conditional expression was evaluated as True', removed in 2.23; remove or correct such expressions so they are strictly boolean.
questions: 'Empty conditional expression was evaluated as True' warning, how do I fix it?
My templated when ends up empty, what should I do?

answer_card.title: Fix empty conditional warning
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- debug:
    msg: test
  when: ""   # warns, evaluated as True
```

Remove the empty `when`, or make sure it always yields `true`/`false` (e.g. `when: my_flag | default(false) | bool`). These warnings can be silenced with `deprecation_warnings = False` in `ansible.cfg`, but fixing the content is better because the behaviour is **removed in ansible-core 2.23**.
